disclaimer.title: Before you start
disclaimer.intro: Spike is a personal helper tool that displays glucose readings from your CGM (Dexcom, Libre, or Nightscout). It is provided as-is, with no warranties.
disclaimer.keepOpenBody: Alarms only work while Spike is open on screen. If you lock your phone, switch to another app, or close Spike, it stops checking your glucose and will NOT alarm. Leave it open with the screen on, ideally plugged in.
disclaimer.notMedicalBody: This app is NOT a medical device and should NOT be used as your sole source for glucose monitoring. Always rely on your official CGM receiver or app for medical decisions.
disclaimer.noDataBody: Your credentials are stored securely on your device only. Glucose data is fetched directly from your CGM provider’s servers to your phone. We do not collect, store, or transmit any of your data.
disclaimer.supplementaryBody: The alarms in this app are meant to supplement, not replace, your CGM alerts. Do not disable your CGM alarms.

dexcom.hint: Use the sharer's credentials (the account connected to the sensor), not a follower account. Share must be turned on in the Dexcom app. If no readings come in, invite a follower (it can be you).

libre.hint: Use your LibreLinkUp credentials (the follower app, not LibreLink).

nightscout.hint: Enter your Nightscout site URL. Add a readable token if your site requires authentication.

errors.invalidCredentials: Invalid credentials or account not found
errors.invalidDexcom: Invalid credentials or account not found. Check that the region (EU, US, JP) matches your Dexcom account.
errors.accountLocked: Account locked after too many failed logins. Try again later.

monitor.credentialsRejected: Your CGM account rejected the saved password. Spike stopped checking glucose so your account doesn't get locked. Log in again to resume alarms.
monitor.accountLocked: Your CGM account is temporarily locked after too many failed logins. Spike stopped checking glucose. Wait a while, then log in again.

settings.soundHint: Tap a sound to hear it.
settings.snoozeWarning: Snoozing longer than {{count}} minutes may delay critical alerts. Use with caution.

info.trendLine: Shows your recent readings as dots under the number, so you can tell a sudden drop from a slow one.
info.trendWindow: How many hours the trend line covers. LibreLinkUp only keeps about 12 hours of readings.
info.delta: How much glucose changed over the last 5 minutes, shown under the arrow. Hidden when there's no reading from about 5 minutes ago.
info.nightMode: Dims the monitor between the hours you set, so it doesn't light up the room. It goes back to full brightness while an alarm is going off.
info.nightBrightness: How bright the monitor stays at night. Lower is darker.
info.predictedLow: Goes off when glucose is still in range but on track to drop below Low in the next {{count}} minutes.
info.predictedHigh: Goes off when glucose is still in range but on track to rise above High in the next {{count}} minutes.
info.rapidFall: Goes off when your CGM shows glucose falling fast (↓ or ↓↓), whatever the value.
info.rapidRise: Goes off when your CGM shows glucose rising fast (↑ or ↑↑), whatever the value.
info.noData: Goes off when no new reading arrives for a while: the sensor lost signal, the phone is offline, or the CGM app stopped sharing.
info.noDataAfter: How long without a new reading before the No Data alarm goes off.
info.repeatOther: How often Low, High, predicted, rapid-change and No Data alarms repeat while the situation lasts. Urgent Low and Urgent High always repeat every {{count}} minutes.
info.snooze: Shows a Snooze button on the monitor while an alarm is active, to silence alarms for a few minutes.
info.snoozeDuration: How long Snooze silences alarms. If you drop to Urgent Low while snoozed, the snooze ends and the alarm goes off.

noData.title: No Data alarm
noData.body: Rings when readings stop for a while, like when the sensor loses signal. On by default.

predicted.title: Predicted Low / High
predicted.body: Warns you before glucose crosses a line. Off by default: turn it on in Settings.

delta.title: Delta
delta.body: The change over the last 5 minutes, under the arrow. Off by default.

trendWindow.title: Longer trend line
trendWindow.body: Show 2, 6 or 12 hours of readings, so you can see the whole night.

info.title: Settings explained
info.body: Tap ⓘ next to a setting to see what it does.
